lenses.name: Steve Jobs Product Lens
lenses.summary: Focus on user experience, simplicity, and saying no to a thousand good ideas so the essential few shine.

lenses.name: Toyota Lean Lens
lenses.summary: Eliminate waste, make work visible, pull value through the system, and improve continuously from reality.

lenses.name: CFO ROI Lens
lenses.summary: Measure cost, expected return, risk, and opportunity cost; challenge anything that does not produce measurable leverage.

lenses.name: Customer Ease Lens
lenses.summary: Judge every step from the customer's first confusion to their first success. Friction is failure.

lenses.name: Competition Lens
lenses.summary: Map the competitive landscape, anticipate counter-moves, and avoid building what is already commoditized.

lenses.name: Wisdom Memory Lens
lenses.summary: Before deciding, look at what we already proved, disproved, or assumed. The past is the cheapest consultant.
